_why: Rewritten for Nueva 2026-09-09. Every one of these three pages was the donor's, wholesale:
donor system, donor logo, donor funnel name, donor copy, and links that pointed at ANOTHER
COMPANY'S live properties. A Nueva rep opening 'How to use this funnel' was being sent to
glpshark.com/training-hub and shown Beneve's and GLP's funnel walkthrough videos. That is not
a cosmetic donor trace, it hands your rep someone else's material.
VIDEOS ARE EMPTY ON PURPOSE. The three that were here belong to Beneve and GLP and are hosted
on their Vimeo accounts. No Nueva walkthrough has been recorded, and a how-to page with no
video is honest where a how-to page with a competitor's video is not. Add them here when they
SCRIPTS CARDS ARE ABSENT ON PURPOSE. They pointed at a beneve_scripts_base_url merge field,
a custom value that exists in NO account, so all four buttons per page resolved to
'https:///skin-diagnostic-scripts'. Nueva has no scripts hub yet (nueva_sample_scripts_url is
empty and there is no scripts funnel). Building one is the fix; pointing four cards at an empty
custom value would just be four dead links with a Nueva name on them.
